key_insight: XM-19 stainless steel welds showed A-mode solidification and interdendritic Z-phase in both GTAW and fiber laser welding, but their dominant solidification morphologies differed.
engineering_relevance: These findings inform welding-process development for XM-19 as a potential structural material for small modular reactor pressure vessels.
method: Produced autogenous GTAW and fiber laser welds.
Examined weld morphology and microstructure using microscopy.
Evaluated solidification behavior using solidification-mode prediction.
evidence_signal: Across all investigated welding conditions, both processes exhibited A-mode solidification, and microscopy identified Z-phase in interdendritic regions.
watch_item: The abstract reports no mechanical-property or corrosion testing, so pressure-vessel service suitability remains unverified.
paper_title: Welding Characteristics of Type XM-19 Stainless Steel
